newsitem.title: FRANCE: Sanofi rises on hopes of U.S. drug results.
newsitem.headline: Sanofi rises on hopes of U.S. drug results.

text.p: Shares in French drugs company Sanofi rose sharply on Tuesday on hopes that results due on Wednesday on tests of a heart drug in the United States would be positive for the company, traders said.

The American Heart Association is due to announce test results of Sanofi's Clopidogrel formula tomorrow, a Sanofi spokesman told Reuters. He stressed that the company did not know the results, which would only be released on Wednesday. The commercial name for the drug would be Plavix.
Sanofi stock firmed 1.65 percent to 467.60 francs on volume of 157,377 shares at 1130 GMT.
"The results will be known tomorrow. We do not know the results," the spokesman said.
Sanofi could market the Plavix drug with Bristol-Myers Squibb Co, he added.
Health and beauty products group Sanofi is majority-owned by Elf Aquitaine.
